method: A promotion is listed only when the bank's own page states it. Where no savings-account opening bonus appears on the bank's own account page, the row says so and links the page that was checked - that is a statement about the page, not a claim that no offer exists anywhere.

promotions.headline: $100 or $200 cash bonus for a new Chase Savings account
promotions.requirements: Open a new Chase Savings account with the offer code; deposit qualifying new money within 30 days of offer enrollment (bonus determined on day 30); maintain the new money for 90 days from offer enrollment. Bonus paid within 15 days after that.
promotions.eligibility: New Chase savings customers only. Not available to existing Chase savings customers, or to accounts closed within 90 days or closed with a negative balance in the last 3 years. One new savings-account bonus every two years; one bonus per account.

promotions.headline: $50 or $400 cash bonus plus a 1.10% APY boost for up to 6 months

tiers.requirement: Eligible direct deposit of $1,000 or more

promotions.requirements: Open a new SoFi savings account and set up an eligible direct deposit of $1,000 or more. The 1.10% APY boost applies to one savings account for up to 6 months when eligible direct deposit is set up within 60 days, and the account is opened by 12/31/27. Alternatively, $5,000 in qualifying deposits every 31 days maintains the boosted rate.
promotions.eligibility: New SoFi checking and savings customers. Opening savings automatically opens a SoFi checking account.

promotions.headline: +1.00% APY for 3 months for both referrer and referee
promotions.requirements: Open a Marcus Online Savings Account and refer a friend who is new to Marcus using your unique referral link. Both parties earn a 1.00% APY rate boost for 3 months on accounts where they are primary owner. Up to 5 referrals per customer.
promotions.eligibility: Referee must be new to Marcus and must use the referral link.

promotions.headline: 3.25% APY on Platinum Savings for new savings customers with $25,000+
promotions.requirements: Deposit and maintain $25,000 or more in a new Platinum Savings account within 30 days. Rate is variable.
promotions.eligibility: New Wells Fargo savings customers only.

promotions.headline: Up to 3.50% APY with a U.S. Bank relationship and $25,000+ combined qualifying balances
promotions.requirements: Own a Bank Smartly Checking account, Safe Debit account or Bank Smartly Visa Signature card, and hold combined qualifying balances of $25,000 or more.
promotions.eligibility: Account owners of an eligible U.S. Bank product.
